verdict.rationale: Penpot offers programmatic routes that could drive bulk changes. Its MCP server and open plugin API give 'extensive access to objects and properties' for workflow automation and 'automate tedious tasks'. Component main updates propagate to all linked copies, a built-in form of bulk update. However, no evidence documents explicit batch or bulk operations across many items, so bulk behavior must be scripted by the agent or plugin. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch edit APIs or MCP tools, multi-file or multi-object operation examples, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven bulk edits.
